title: Information Technology Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN:

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Senior Support Specialist to provide advanced technical support for users and systems within a corporate IT environment. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID (Azure AD), and user support through ticketing systems. This professional will also handle basic Windows and Linux server maintenance and perform network troubleshooting as needed. The role involves ensuring service stability, maintaining system integrity, and collaborating with infrastructure and security teams to improve operational efficiency and end-user experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for users, resolving incidents and service requests via the ticketing system.
  • Administer and maintain Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Intune.
  • Manage user accounts, groups, and access permissions in Entra ID (Azure Active Directory). Perform basic maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting of Windows and Linux servers. Support network-related issues such as connectivity, DHCP, DNS, and VPN access.
  • Document technical procedures, configurations, and solutions. Collaborate with other IT teams on escalations, system improvements

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Proven experience in IT support, preferably in corporate or enterprise environments. Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and Entra ID (Azure AD). Basic understanding of Windows Server and Linux environments.
  • Basic knowledge of network concepts (LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
  • Experience with IT ticketing systems and customer support.
  • Advanced English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS-900, MD-102, AZ-104).
  • Experience with automation tools such as PowerShell or scripting.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices or similar support frameworks.

Excellent communication skills and a proactive, problem-solving attitude.

At Shein, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Especialista Controladoria Logística (Finance)
description:
About Us:

CNH Industrial is a world-class equipment and services company dedicated to advancing the noble work of agriculture and construction workers. Driven by our shared purpose of Breaking New Ground, we are passionate about bringing Innovation, Sustainability, and Productivity to all that we do. As a truly global company, CNH Industrial’s 37,000+ employees form part of a diverse and inclusive workplace, focused on empowering customers to grow, and build, a better world through our core brands: Case IH, STEYR, New Holland Agriculture, CASE, and New Holland Construction.

In Precision Technology, we make iron smarter. Our team members deliver innovative solutions helping our customers to be more productive, save time, lower costs, and to operate sustainably. From vehicle displays, application controls, steering solutions, digital services, and telematics, to fully autonomous driverless technology, we develop solutions that solve challenges for customers around the world.

#GrowACareer.

#BuildAFuture.

Atividades Inbound

  • Gestão de provisões (accruals) de frete inbound, assegurando correto reconhecimento contábil e compliance com auditoria.
  • Controle de custos de transporte inbound (rodoviário, marítimo, aéreo e serviços logísticos)
  • Gestão financeira do WMF Brasil, incluindo controle de despesas logísticas, alocação por centro de lucro e acompanhamento das movimentações entre plantas e o 3PL.
  • Controle e atualização de custos std (standard cost) de transporte inbound, garantindo que cada item consumido tenha o frete std corretamente atrelado e que as variações (real vs. std) sejam explicadas e reportadas.
  • Análise de variações (budget vs. forecast vs. real) para identificar desvios de frete spot, demurrage, escolta, armazenagem e propor planos de ação junto ao time de operações.
  • Elaboração de relatórios para liderança (MOR, Forecast Reviews, CFO updates), traduzindo os impactos logísticos em indicadores financeiros claros.
  • Interface com áreas globais e locais (Operações, Contratos, Fiscal/Tax, Tesouraria e Engenharia) para garantir aderência a normas contábeis, regulatórias e compliance (incluindo SOX).
  • Análise de impactos de tarifas, impostos e regulações aduaneiras (Recof, Ex-Tarifário, alterações de Incoterm), consolidando ganhos e perdas no resultado.
  • Suporte em BID/RFQ de transportadoras, avaliando cenários financeiros, savings potenciais e impactos no budget/forecast.
  • Monitoramento de KPIs financeiros logísticos, como custo por tonelada/km, saturação de caminhões, waiting hours e demurrage, consolidando dashboards para decisão.

Requisitos:

Superior completo.

Experiência em finanças e controladoria, com sólidos conhecimentos contábeis.

Experiência com melhoria de processos e implementação de melhores práticas.

Experiência em suporte a auditorias e garantia de conformidade com a SOX e controles internos.

Experiência em ambientes multinacionais, com relatórios e colaboração entre equipes globais.

Experiência prática com análise financeira, previsão e planejamento estratégico (FP&A).

Experiência prévia com estruturas de custos e impactos financeiros de transporte/logística de entrada (preferencial).

Inglês Avançado

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3 to 5+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI

Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Marketing Cloud Senior Developer - Salesforce
description:
Marketing Cloud Senior Developer - Salesforce

Visão Geral da Posição

O Desenvolvedor Sênior de Marketing Cloud será responsável por desenvolver soluções dentro da plataforma Salesforce Marketing Cloud para apoiar funções críticas de negócio e atender aos requisitos de projetos.

Essa função exige uma combinação sólida de proficiência técnica, pensamento criativo e atenção aos detalhes . O profissional colaborará de perto com equipes de marketing, design, dados e gestão de campanhas para entregar experiências digitais impactantes que envolvam milhões de clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implantar soluções complexas de automação de marketing utilizando o Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Cloud Pages e Mobile Studio).
  • Implementar personalização e segmentação baseadas em dados , utilizando Data Extensions, consultas SQL e lógica AMPscript .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar Cloud Pages, formulários e landing pages integradas aos dados e APIs do Marketing Cloud.
  • Criar e manter jornadas e automações para campanhas gatilhadas, comportamentais e de ciclo de vida .
  • Projetar e implementar fluxos de integração de dados entre o SFMC e outros sistemas (Sales/Service Cloud, CDP ou fontes de dados externas).
  • Criar e gerenciar Data Extensions, atividades de consulta e processos de automação para garantir fluxo de dados eficiente.
  • Trabalhar com APIs (REST/SOAP) e Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) para integrações avançadas e conteúdo dinâmico.
  • Seguir padrões de codificação e melhores práticas dentro do ecossistema Marketing Cloud.
  • Atuar como especialista técnico (SME) em todos os trabalhos de desenvolvimento relacionados ao SFMC.
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e equipes de operações de marketing para impulsionar melhorias na plataforma e implementar novas funcionalidades.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes de marketing e design para transformar conceitos criativos em soluções tecnicamente viáveis.
  • Revisar códigos e orientar desenvolvedores juniores , garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos , otimizando para velocidade, confiabilidade e engajamento.
  • Supervisionar testes de renderização e entregabilidade utilizando ferramentas como o Litmus .
  • Manter altos padrões de privacidade de dados, conformidade (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) e segurança.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de analytics para estabelecer rastreamento de performance, relatórios e insights a partir dos dados do SFMC.
  • Avaliar continuamente novos recursos do SFMC, atualizações e melhores práticas do mercado para aprimorar as capacidades da plataforma.
  • Explorar e implementar recursos de IA, personalização e inteligência preditiva dentro do Marketing Cloud.

Habilidades e Experiência:

  • Graduação em TI, Ciência da Computação ou área equivalente , com 7 a 10 anos de experiência em TI e mínimo de 5 anos com Salesforce Marketing Cloud .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da plataforma Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) e compreensão dos conceitos essenciais de e-mail marketing e automação .
  • Experiência com Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automations, SQL, Content Builder e criação de audiências para Advertising Studio .
  • Proficiência em HTML, CSS, JavaScript e AMPscript para desenvolvimento de e-mails.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e experiência em testes e depuração de e-mails usando o Litmus .
  • Compreensão das melhores práticas da Salesforce para automação de marketing .
  • Capacidade e vontade de trabalhar com alto grau de autonomia e senso de propriedade em uma equipe geograficamente distribuída , composta por outros desenvolvedores e recursos de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal .
  • Ingles avançado

Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.

Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.

title: CONSULTOR(A) CIENTISTA DADOS II
description:
QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

GS: 17

Local: Jacareí / SP (Hibrido)

Inscrições até: 06/11/2025

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.

You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.

This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.

Who are we?

BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .

What we expect from you:

  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;

  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;

Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Strategic Projects Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others.

We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

Vammo is hiring a strategic, high-performing leader to join our Special Projects & Strategy team - a small, elite group working directly with executives and founders - to solve the most complex and high-impact challenges in the company. You’ll drive cross-functional initiatives that shape Vammo’s growth trajectory - from fleet and asset optimization to financial modeling, new business models, partnerships, and operational scaling.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, loves tackling hard problems, and moves seamlessly between data, strategy, and execution. You will be deeply embedded across teams - working hand-in-hand with Fleet, Charging, Maintenance, Sales, Software, and Hardware - and expected to think like an owner.

You will be based in São Paulo and will report directly to executives at Vammo

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute high-impact strategic projects that directly influence Vammo’s operational and financial performance.
  • Partner with functional leaders to identify bottlenecks, design solutions, and drive implementation.
  • Build analytical frameworks and dashboards to inform decision-making across the company.
  • Develop business cases, models, and strategic plans for new initiatives — from asset financing structures to expansion playbooks.
  • Own key cross-functional workstreams (e.g., pricing, network expansion, strategic partnerships).
  • Translate insights into clear recommendations and operational action.
  • Work closely with the founders and leadership team on fundraising, board materials, and strategic communications.
  • Build and mentor small, high-performing project teams as the function scales.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of total experience, ideally including:

2–4 years at a top-tier management consulting firm (BCG, Bain, McKinsey, etc.)

3–4 years in a high-growth startup or operating role where you owned key projects end-to-end.

  • Proven track record of leading and executing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills — comfortable in Excel, PowerPoint, and with messy data.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize ruthlessly, and move fast.
  • Strong business judgment and curiosity about how hardware, logistics, and software intersect.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish or Chinese a plus.
  • Based in São Paulo, with willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.
  • Strong alignment with Vammo’s mission and values.

Benefits

  • A front-row seat at one of Latin America’s most ambitious hardware and climate tech startups, backed by world-class investors.
  • A mission-driven environment where every decision contributes to decarbonizing mobility and empowering low-income workers.
  • Exposure to all areas of the business — you’ll work directly with the founders and leadership team on company-defining decisions.
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you can handle — and grow faster than anywhere else.
  • Competitive compensation and equity package.
  • Health insurance and benefits.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, and purpose-driven team that loves to build real things in the real world.

Vammo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or any other protected factor.

title: QHSE Coordinator
description:
About the Company

Munksjö is a leading international manufacturer of decor paper for surface finishing on wood-based panels.

Our mission is to create comfortable living and working environments , always driven by innovation, quality, and environmental responsibility .

We develop and deliver innovative and customized decorative paper solutions , which, after further processing, are used in the production of furniture, laminate flooring, and surface materials for both indoor and outdoor applications.

At Munksjö, we believe that taking responsibility for the future of our planet is a priority — sustainability is at the core of everything we do.

About the Role

We are seeking a QHSE Coordinator with proven focus on environmental management to join our team in Caieiras-SP.

This professional will be responsible for ensuring the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of QHSE systems and practices, with a strong emphasis on environmental compliance and performance .

The role plays a key part in promoting a sustainability-driven culture , ensuring alignment with environmental legislation, corporate goals, and best practices .

Responsibilities

Environmental Management

  • Plan, implement, and monitor sustainability and environmental management programs.
  • Track and analyze environmental KPIs (emissions, effluents, waste, energy, and water consumption).
  • Ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations, and licenses.
  • Conduct and manage internal and external audits.
  • Lead environmental impact mitigation and carbon neutrality projects.
  • Develop environmental awareness and engagement campaigns.
  • Oversee supplier and partner compliance with environmental requirements.
  • Lead strategic environmental initiatives (e.g., zero landfill, waste segregation).
  • Support occupational health and safety programs and accident prevention initiatives.
  • Monitor HSE indicators and propose corrective/preventive actions.
  • Maintain and enhance the Integrated Management System (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
  • Coordinate QHSE training and awareness activities.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and zero accidents.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Degree in Environmental Engineering, Production Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree in Environmental Management, Sustainability, or related areas (preferred).
  • Fluent English (mandatory).

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in QHSE, with proven focus on environmental management.
  • Experience in multinational organizations, interacting with corporate and external stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of leading environmental projects.

Technical Knowledge:

  • Brazilian environmental legislation.
  • Waste, effluent, and emission management.
  • Continuous improvement and risk analysis tools.
  • Environmental and sustainability performance indicators (ESG).
  • Understanding of GHG Scopes 1, 2, and 3.

title: Senior Consultant - Treasury (Brazil)
description:
Senior Consultant - Treasury, Financial Transactions & Accounting

Fully remote position offering a flexible work schedule.

Location: LATAM (Brazil)

You’ll work with top-tier clients across industries - multinationals, banks, and government entities. You're not just executing tasks, you’re leading workstreams, shaping recommendations, and driving change in treasury organizations.

About us:

Founded in 2003 by Chad Wekelo, Actualize Consulting emerged from a vision to create a niche firm where every team member is valued as a collaborator rather than just an employee. Drawing from his Big Four experience, Chad, alongside partners Matt Seu and COO, Kerry Wekelo; built a company specializing in Capital Markets, Mortgage and Fixed Income, and Treasury Operations. Their leadership fostered a culture rooted in gratitude, trust, and growth. Kerry's personal journey led to the development of wellness-based principles that transformed the company's culture. This commitment to employee well being and mutual respect has earned Actualize numerous accolades, including recognition as a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and Great Place to Work Certified. Beyond internal culture, Actualize is dedicated to diversity, inclusion, and community impact, and a belief that a people-first approach drives both personal fulfillment and professional excellence.

Job description:

We are seeking a Senior Consultant with expertise in financial transactions, treasury management systems, and accounting advisory. In this role, you will advise clients on optimizing their treasury operations, cash management, and transaction accounting processes, while ensuring compliance with IFRS/US GAAP and best practices. You will work closely with CFOs, Treasurers, and finance teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, from system implementation and integration to technical accounting guidance for complex treasury transactions.

Required Skills:

• Lead client engagements focused on treasury management systems (TMS) implementation, configuration, and optimization

• Advise on accounting treatment for cash, liquidity, hedging, financial instruments, and intercompany transactions.

• Support clients with treasury transformation projects, including process automation and system enhancements.

• Provide technical expertise on treasury-related accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated consulting solutions.

• Mentor junior consultants and contribute to practice development.

Desired Skills:

• Experience in financial services or corporate treasury environment

• Solid analytical and quantitative skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with financial modeling is a plus.

• System/software implementation experience

• Exposure to financial instruments including derivatives, funding, and investments

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting

CFA, CPA, or CTP certification is preferred

English: Able to communicate fluently, you will work with a multicultural team and consultants from other countries.

Contact/application information:

Please submit your resume to . If accepted, we’ll be in touch to schedule an interview. 

Thank you!

title: ESPECIALISTA DE TRANSFORMAÇÃO
description:

Possui o mandato de acelerar as transformações organizacionais, aproveitando sua visão transversal da companhia para fortalecer a conexão entre as capacidades de negócios e seus diferenciais competitivos.

O Especialista de Transformação atua como agente acelerador de transformações em um negócio específico, assegurando o desdobramento da Estratégia em iniciativas, identificando sinergias com outras áreas e negócios, além de destravar bloqueios e construir pontes entre diferentes estruturas da companhia visando alcançar os objetivos estratégicos.

  • Acompanhar a gestão de portfólio de iniciativas das áreas/negócios que atua
  • Participar de ritos e suportar os líderes das áreas de negócio para evoluir nas práticas de gestão propostas pelo Transformation Office;
  • Identificar oportunidades de sinergia com os demais Especialistas de Transformação e propor soluções para que os benefícios identificados sejam capturados entre áreas/negócios;
  • Conduzir iniciativas cross que estejam relacionadas com o escopo da diretoria;
  • Contribuir com a construção, condução e implementação de melhorias, processos e métodos de gestão organizacional e desdobramento de estratégia;
  • Adaptar-se rapidamente a novas demandas e mudanças no ambiente corporativo, promovendo uma abordagem flexível e ágil.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excel avançado (não necessário VBA);
  • Experiência com gestão de projetos ou PMO, voltados à transformação.
  • Experiência com construção e condução de apresentações: apresentando familiaridade com storytelling, independente de qual ferramenta será utilizada;
  • Construção e análise de dados, conhecimento de Power BI para elaboração de relatórios;
  • Comunicação eficaz;
  • Foco em resultado.

Diferencial:

  • Formação: Engenharias, Administração, Ciências exatas, Economia (preferencial)

  • Pós graduação em áreas correlatas com o desafio.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.

Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: COORDENADOR(A) DE PROCESSOS
description:
QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

DADOS:

Local: Aracruz/ES

Inscrições até: 31/10/2025

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Responsável pela coordenação e desenvolvimento da equipe de Engenharia de Processos para atingimento das metas através de coaching, feedbacks e treinamentos, integração do processo junto a gestão de rotina e gerenciamento dos ativos da área;
  • Responsável em coordenar e orientar programas de troubleshooting e assegurar a execução dos planos de ação oriundos destas análises, dentro dos padrões de qualidade que garantam a resolução de problemas de processo;
  • Responsável em coordenar junto as gerências de produção as oportunidades de melhoria de processo e redução de custo (aumento de produção e redução de custos melhoria da qualidade de produtos, meio ambiente);
  • Responsável pela coordenação de grupos de trabalhos visando solução de problemas técnicos de alta complexidade relacionados com matéria prima, processo e produto;
  • Responsável por elaborador trabalhos focados em melhoria continua para evolução das unidades e padronização das mesmas;
  • Responsável por gerar visibilidade dos dados e comparativos entre as unidades buscando promover evolução do negócio;
  • Acompanhamento de não conformidades e ações corretiva;
  • Elaboração de balanços que proporcionem visão sistêmica para melhores práticas e ajustes;
  • Avaliação dos processos produtivos e produtos finais, definindo consumo específico de matérias primas, assistência técnica aos clientes visando aumentar a produtividade;
  • Planejamento, Controle e Execução de Testes Industriais, Garantia e Controle dos padrões técnicos nos processos;
  • Participar em projetos de modificações e melhoria do processo, máquinas e equipamentos, por meio de informações, estudos e conhecimentos técnicos;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria constante na qualidade do produto, desenvolvendo novos fornecedores e aprimorando os já existentes, por meio de parceria com o fornecedor e suprimentos;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos operacionais e administrativos referentes a qualidade dos produtos e serviços.

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Formação superior em Engenharia Química, Produção, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável especialização na área de processos;
  • Experiencia na área de engenharia de processos;
  • Experiencia no segmento de celulose ou tissue;
  • Desejável Inglês Intermediário.

Informações adicionais

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;

Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos;

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas família, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe que tiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial;

Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira baixo:

  • Tele Faz Bem: Atendimento gratuito e confidencial ao colaborador(a) Suzano e seus(as) dependentes(as) nas seguintes frentes: Apoio psicológico e de assistência social, orientação jurídica, financeira, de atividade física e nutricional;
  • Plataforma de saúde mental – A Wellz, oferece sessões de terapia online subsidiadas pela Suzano de forma confidencial, além de várias oportunidades de auto cuidado como jornadas, diário de humor, terapia em grupo, entre outros;
  • Plataforma de saúde física – A Wellhub é uma plataforma completa de bem estar com acesso a academias, aplicativos e aulas on-line com liberdade de escolha de atividades.
  • Programa de gestantes – O programa “Bebê Saudável” realiza o acompanhamento gestacional através de contato telefônico e abordagens, além do recebimento de um kit personalizado.

Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. title: Analista Renda Fixa Crédito Privado PL - Asset
description:
Descrição da área

A área de Renda Fixa Crédito Privado, parte do braço de Asset Management do Grupo Daycoval, abrange a carteira de ativos financeiros que constituem títulos de dívida para tomada de recursos junto ao mercado de capitais. Divide-se em duas macros atividades (ou células): a Gestão de Portfólio e a Pesquisa de Crédito (ou Credit Research ).

A célula de Credit Research desempenha, principalmente, a função de analisar os emissores de títulos de dívida acerca de diversos fatores de risco, dentre eles, destacadamente o risco de crédito. Apoia-se em uma política de gerenciamento de risco de crédito própria, que norteia os principais preceitos para a aplicação da análise de risco e demais processos subsequentes, tais como o monitoramento de resultados dos emissores e fluxos avulsos e pontuais (assembleias, pipeline, documentos regulatórios, etc). Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar o mercado de crédito privado, desde o pipeline e o fluxo de notícias até eventos pontuais, como assembleias e comunicados ou fatos relevantes;

  • Analisar a estrutura dos instrumentos de crédito privado;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento periódico da qualidade de crédito dos emissores por meio de monitoramentos de resultados;
  • Conduzir avaliações de aspectos ambientais, sociais e de governança (ESG) sobre os emissores.

Qualificações

  • Conhecimento sólido em contabilidade, finanças e mercados de crédito;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados, como Excel VBA, plataformas da CVM e Economatica;

  • Certificações em Research ou Gestão, como CNPI, CGA ou CGE.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia, preferencialmente, em Credit Research, em gestoras de recursos (Asset Management) ou em DCM (Debt Capital Markets);

  • Mínimo de dois anos de experiência em Asset ou DCM, e três anos ou mais em Equity Research, Agência de Rating ou áreas de Risco de Crédito em instituições financeiras.

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Inglês em nível intermediário;
  • Facilidade na elaboração de materiais e relatórios executivos (PowerPoint e ferramentas similares);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e senso de organização.

No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. title: Coordenador de infraestrutura de Redes
description:
Vaga: Coordenador de Infraestrutura de Redes

Descrição:

Buscamos um profissional para coordenar a infraestrutura de redes em nossa organização. O Coordenador de Infraestrutura de Redes será responsável pelo planejamento, implementação, manutenção e monitoramento das redes corporativas, garantindo segurança, performance e alta disponibilidade. Este profissional atuará diretamente com a equipe técnica e com outros departamentos, assegurando a continuidade dos serviços e a conformidade com as políticas internas e externas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Planejamento e Arquitetura de Redes: Revisão e implementação de soluções para redes corporativas.
  • Gerenciamento de Desempenho e Disponibilidade: Garantir alta performance e confiabilidade da infraestrutura de redes.
  • Suporte Técnico: Gerenciamento de incidentes, resolução de problemas e implementação de soluções preventivas.
  • Compliance e Auditorias: Garantir conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentos externos.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Redes: Experiência com dispositivos como switches, roteadores, firewalls e ferramentas de monitoramento (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds).
  • Infraestrutura de TI: Conhecimentos em LAN, WAN, VPNs, servidores e armazenamento.
  • Segurança de Redes: Implementação de medidas de segurança (firewalls, criptografia, VPN, controle de acesso).
  • Cloud e Virtualização: Experiência com virtualização de redes (SDN, NFV) e integração com AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud.

Competências de Gestão:

  • Liderança: Coordenação de equipes técnicas, delegação de tarefas e desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Gestão de Projetos: Planejamento e execução de projetos de infraestrutura de rede.
  • Gestão de Conflitos: Habilidade em resolver conflitos e manter o ambiente produtivo.

Formação e Certificações:

  • Graduação em áreas como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Redes ou afins.
  • Certificações como CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, CISSP, CISM ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect.

Vivência:

  • Vivência Consolidada em infraestrutura de TI, com experiência em redes de médio e grande porte.
  • Vivência em gestão de equipes e ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

Habilidades Interpessoais:

  • Comunicação: Capacidade de explicar questões técnicas para equipes não técnicas e gerenciar relatórios executivos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Colaboração com outros departamentos para entender necessidades e fornecer soluções adequadas.

description:
Lead the design and implementation of training and educational programs to support the adoption and sustained use of the Insujet™ System in (Country), in alignment with Sol-Millennium Medical Ltd’s commercial strategy.

Job Responsibilities

  1. Serve as the Clinical Product Specialist for the Insujet™ portfolio, delivering expert support to external stakeholders during product launches, evaluations, and clinical trials.
  2. Provide clinical insights and user feedback to inform internal teams on regulatory compliance and future product development strategies.
  3. Build and maintain strategic relationships with key opinion leaders, clinicians, allied health professionals, and patient advocacy groups to enhance awareness and endorsement of the Insujet™ System within the diabetes community.
  4. Develop targeted educational and training resources to support effective adoption and sustained use of the Insujet™ System among intended user populations.
  5. Deliver specialized training programs to healthcare professionals, equipping them to confidently and safely support patients in long-term use of the Insujet™ System.
  6. Coordinate clinical evaluations with healthcare providers to drive adoption, while collecting real-world evidence for publications, case studies, and white papers that support marketing, documentation, and training initiatives.
  7. Collect and document real-world data on clinical outcomes and product usability from patients and healthcare professionals using standardized tools.
  8. Provide post-market support to ensure continued and effective use of the Insujet™ System.
  9. Share insights and feedback from training and education activities with internal teams to inform ongoing improvements.
  10. Participate in complaint data collection in line with company policies and regulatory standards.
  11. Contribute to product innovation by working closely with the broader Insujet™ team to inform future product development.

Job Requirements

1. Bachelor’s degree or higher in medicine, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Business/Marketing or a related field.

2. 3+ years of experience working in a pharmaceutical or medical devices company; diabetes related knowledge /product experience is advantageous.

3. Proven clinical account management skills, with the ability to independently

develop and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs).

4. Knowledge of the healthcare industry; experience in diabetes/endocrinology

products are desired.

5. Strong presentation and training skills to educate HCPs and patients on

correct product usage.

6. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and data analysis Clinical

knowledge or medical background essential, with the ability to understand

and explain technical product details.

7. Results-driven with strong resilience and execution ability.

8. Excellent teamwork and communication skills.

Are you looking to join a dynamic and innovative company in the medical device industry? Nugen Medical Devices, based in Canada, is at the forefront of needle-free drug delivery technology. Our proprietary technology, approved for market by our subsidiary EPG (European pharma group B.V.), is revolutionizing the way medications are administered. EPG, an ISO 13485 certified company, specializes in the design, development, manufacturing, sales, and distribution of needle-free devices. Our flagship product, InsuJet, is an innovative needle-free insulin administration device designed to meet the needs of diabetes patients by providing a painless alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With locations in the Netherlands and China, we work with both local and international partners to develop and expand our cutting-edge solutions.

In the Netherlands, we are based in Schiphol-Rijk, conveniently located just below Amsterdam and its international airport Schiphol.

We are seeking talented individuals to join our team and contribute to the production scale-up of this groundbreaking technology.

Nugen Medical Devices is also preparing a unique needle-free sterile packaging solution that will enable us to expand into a variety of pharmaceutical applications.

Join us and be part of a team that is making a difference in the healthcare industry!

  • Diagnóstico e plano de ação para maturidade DevOps: mapear processos, ferramentas e práticas atuais, identificando gargalos e propondo um plano de evolução com prioridades claras para eficiência, automação e confiabilidade;
  • Estabilização e automação dos pipelines de CI/CD: puxar a revisão, padronização e automação de pipelines, garantindo versionamento, rastreabilidade e segurança das implantações, além de implementar práticas como blue/green deploy ou rollback automatizado;
  • Governança e confiabilidade dos ambientes: implementar processos e ferramentas que fortaleçam segurança, configuração e monitoramento, utilizando infraestrutura como código (ex.: Terraform), além de fomentar a cultura de observabilidade e resposta proativa a incidentes;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time de DevOps e promover boas práticas de engenharia em toda a organização;
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de performance e disponibilidade em sistemas distribuídos.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis ;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CI/CD e automação (Jenkins, GitLab, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, ArgoCD, etc.);
  • Vivência em infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares);
  • Conhecimento avançado em linguagens de scripting/automação (Python, Ruby, Shell Script);
  • Linux avançado (obrigatório) e experiência com Windows Server;
  • Fundamentos de redes, protocolos e segurança ;
  • Experiência em cloud computing (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e boas práticas de otimização de custo/performance;
  • Containers e orquestração ( Docker, Kubernetes );
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog ou similares).

Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: Logistics & 3PL Operations Specialist
description:
About us

OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

Our footprint covers more than 70 countries and regions , supported by over 300,000 sales outlets and 3,300 official service centers. We employ more than 40,000 dedicated professionals focused on creating a better life for customers worldwide through smarter products and services.

We are looking for experienced talent to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities

1. Strategic Operations & 3PL Governance

  • Manage and govern the end-to-end national warehouse operations executed by 3PL partners, strategically ensuring peak efficiency in all logistics flows (inbound, outbound, and storage).
  • Oversee and optimize daily 3PL activities, implementing key metrics to maximize service levels, inventory accuracy, and processing timeliness.
  • Serve as the technical authority in high-value inventory control , establishing and maintaining rigorous protocols for IMEI/serial number tracking and reconciliation.

2. Regulatory Compliance & Auditing

  • Ensure full regulatory compliance by maintaining flawless consistency between physical goods, information systems, and complex Brazilian tax documentation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, etc.).
  • Conduct advanced, systematic auditing of 3PL adherence to SOPs and safety protocols, initiating corrective actions and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide expert advisory and practical support for NF-e invoicing , freight reconciliation, and assistance with complex ICMS tax reporting processes.

3. Project Management & Global Interface

  • Independently execute and drive key strategic logistics projects (e.g., major WMS/ERP system rollouts, warehouse network expansion) from planning through implementation.
  • Interface directly with the local Chinese team and Global Headquarters to align local operations with global supply chain strategy, acting as the primary subject matter expert in Brazil.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced English is mandatory (daily use).
  • Chinese is desirable.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in Warehouse Management, 3PL Operations, or Logistics roles, with a proven track record of driving process ownership and high-impact results.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking , exceptional communication, and proven ability to operate with high autonomy and strong results-orientation.

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level mastery of Brazilian logistics and tax legislation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, ICMS).
  • Advanced proficiency in WMS, TMS, and integrated ERP systems.
  • Demonstrated deep experience in managing and controlling high-volume, serialized inventory (IMEI/serial numbers).

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

title: Area Zone Manager
description:
Neptune Group of Companies is a leader in maritime logistics and transportation, offering sustainable, efficient, and innovative solutions across vehicle logistics, dry bulk shipping, and automotive-focused land services. Honoring its family maritime heritage, the Group combines cutting-edge technologies with its signature “Wake Forward” philosophy, driving adaptability and excellence in modern logistics.

The Group includes Neptune Lines, Neptune Shipping Agencies, Neptune Dry Management, Neptune Land Services, and FERST Logistics , each offering specialized expertise. From maritime transport to land-based operations, Neptune Group delivers seamless, end-to-end solutions tailored to its partners’ evolving needs. In this context, the Group is also developing “NLS Port-La-Nouvelle,” its first dedicated automotive port terminal, located in southern France.

Guided by core values of integrity, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, Neptune Group remains committed to driving sustainable growth and strengthening its leadership across the logistics industry.

We are seeking a motivated and commercially driven Area Zone Manager (Latin America) to join our Commercial team. In this role, you will manage the implementation of sales initiatives in order to promote and sell Neptune Group services, generate revenues, and build client relationships with assigned customer accounts or prospective clients, serving as the main sales contact point. You will also be responsible for growing the Group’s services in the assigned territory (mainly Brazil and Argentina), in accordance with corporate objectives, by providing relevant market intelligence, finding and developing qualified leads, and converting them into prospects and clients.

The preferable candidate will be based in Santos (Brazil).

Reporting directly to the Commercial Director, Key Accountabilities include:

  • Drive sales growth in Brazil, Argentina, and wider Latin America by developing and executing territory sales plans.
  • Build strong pipelines and long-term relationships with clients, prospects, and key stakeholders through regular engagement and business reviews.
  • Coordinate the set-up and future management of an agencies’ network, while monitoring competitors, market trends, and risks.
  • Support tenders, prepare quotations, negotiate agreements, and contribute to closing sales.
  • Represent Neptune Lines at client meetings, industry events, and exhibitions to promote services and strengthen brand presence in the region.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, Marketing, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • 8–10 years of proven experience in sales, business development, and account management within the logistics/transportation sector (ocean and air freight, import/export), with a strong track record in Latin American markets.
  • Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (oral and written).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and experience with CRM systems.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Brazil, Argentina, wider Latin America, and occasionally to Neptune Lines’ headquarters in Europe.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify opportunities and deliver growth.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Consultative sales approach with proven negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build strong client and stakeholder relationships at all levels.
  • Self-motivated, resilient, and results driven.

title: Vendedor SDR - Presencial
description:
Descrição do Cargo

Estamos buscando um Vendedor SDR (PJ) para se juntar à nossa equipe em Porto Alegre, RS.

O cargo é focado em prospectar e qualificar leads potenciais através de ligações ativas via telefone e contato inicial com clientes em potencial. As responsabilidades diárias incluem realizar chamadas telefônicas ativas e enviar e-mails para leads, identificar as necessidades dos clientes e agendar demonstrações de produtos com a equipe de vendas. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar contatos via telefone, e-mail, WhatsApp ou LinkedIn com potenciais clientes.
  • Seguir listas segmentadas de leads e utilizar ferramentas de CRM e automação.
  • Identificar decisores dentro das empresas e iniciar conversas qualificadas.
  • Manter relacionamento com leads ainda não prontos para comprar.
  • Enviar conteúdos relevantes, acompanhar respostas e fazer follow-ups programados.
  • Garantir que nenhum lead qualificado “esfrie” por falta de contato.
  • Marcar reuniões entre o lead qualificado e o vendedor (Closer).
  • Preparar o lead com informações sobre a empresa e os próximos passos.
  • Confirmar presença e evitar “no-shows”.
  • Atualizar status dos leads no CRM.
  • Monitorar métricas como taxa de conversão, tempo médio de resposta e volume de prospecções.
  • Identificar gargalos no processo e sugerir melhorias.
  • Dominar ferramentas de CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similar) e seguir rotinas diárias de prospecção.
  • Manter registros detalhados e confiáveis de cada contato.

Perfil desejado:

Habilidades de Comunicação e Relacionamento

  • Saber  escutar com atenção e empatia , especialmente clientes com perfis técnicos e diretos.
  • Ter comunicação  clara, assertiva e sem rodeios , adaptando a linguagem conforme o interlocutor.
  • Gerar conexão emocional  em poucos minutos, valorizando o que o cliente faz e mostrando entendimento do dia a dia de campo.

Diferencial Travicar:  O SDR deve ter tom consultivo —  não empurrar produto, mas puxar diálogo.

Experiência Profissional:

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada em vendas, com foco em prospecção ativa de novos clientes (vendas ativas por telefone), negociação agressiva e fechamento rápido de negócios.
  • Experiência prévia em  prospecção B2B, vendas técnicas  ou  setores agro / tecnologia .
  • Conhecimento básico em  aviação agrícola  é diferencial, mas  treinável .
  • Facilidade com ferramentas digitais: CRM, WhatsApp Business, e-mail, planilhas, e softwares de prospecção.

Formação:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • MBA ou especialização em Vendas ou Gestão de Negócios (completo ou cursando);
  • Inglês e espanhol serão vistos como diferenciais para a vaga.

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.

Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.
  • Preferred: Previous experience with international esports tournaments or live entertainment events. Familiarity with OBS, vMix, or other live production software, and knowledge of streaming infrastructure. Comfortable working under high-pressure live event conditions

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
At MTech Systems, our company mission is to increase yield in protein production to help feed the growing world population without compromising animal welfare or damaging the planet. We aim to create software that delivers real-time data to the entire supply chain that allows producers to get better insight into what is happening on their farms and what they can do to responsibly improve production.

MTech Systems is a prominent provider of tools for managing performance in Live Animal Protein Production. For over 30 years, MTech Systems has provided cutting-edge enterprise data solutions for all aspects of the live poultry operations cycle. We provide our customers with solutions in Business Intelligence, Live Production Accounting, Production Planning, and Remote Data Management—all through an integrated system. Our applications can currently be found running businesses on six continents in over 50 countries. MTech has built an international reputation for equipping our customers with the power to utilize comprehensive data to maximize profitability.

With over 275 employees globally, MTech Systems currently has main offices in Mexico, United States, and Brazil, with additional resources in key markets around the world. MTech Systems USA’s headquarters is based in Atlanta, Georgia and has approximately 90 team members in a casual, collaborative environment. Our work culture here is based on a commitment to helping our clients feed the world, resulting in a flexible and rewarding atmosphere. We are committed to maintaining a work culture that enhances collaboration, provides robust development tools, offers training programs, and allows for direct access to senior and executive management.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong customer-facing experience to join our IT team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of cloud architecture, automation, and customer success. You’ll work closely with internal teams and external customers to design, deploy, and support scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure—primarily in Microsoft Azure.

You’ll play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, supporting SaaS deployments, and ensuring our customers have seamless experience with our cloud-hosted solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong emphasis on communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure to support customer-facing applications.
  • Collaborate with product, development, and customer success teams to ensure infrastructure meets customer needs and SLAs.
  • Lead cloud onboarding and deployment efforts for new customers, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security configuration.
  • Optimize cloud costs and performance through proactive analysis and automation.
  • Serve as a technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders on cloud best practices, security, and architecture.
  • Document infrastructure designs, runbooks, and customer-specific configurations.
  • Provide Tier 3 support for cloud-related issues and participate in incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and recommend improvements to our cloud strategy.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or systems administration, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing or consulting role.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Azure, including Azure AD, networking, storage, and compute services.
  • Must be proficient in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Administrator Associate.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud environments and legacy system integration.
  • Familiarity with customer onboarding, technical account management, or solution architecture.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).

EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is MTech’s commitment to diversity and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. MTech aims to maintain a global inclusive workplace where every person is regarded fairly, appreciated for their uniqueness, advanced according to their accomplishments, and encouraged to fulfill their highest potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at MTech has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Analista de suprimentos Pleno - Comprador
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up , o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Desafio:

Garantir a compra e disponibilidade de materiais, equipamentos e serviços, assegurando as melhores práticas de negociação, otimizando processos de compras, custos e prazos de atendimento a demanda do cliente interno, asseverando o cumprimento das regras de compliance em todo o processo.
